description: Aggregate, keyless market statistics: salary percentiles (p25/p50/p75, annualised EUR) and time-to-fill (days) by job family x country x seniority, plus listing/company/open/closed counts for that segment. Every percentile is suppressed (returned null, never a guess) below a minimum sample size -- null means "not enough data," never zero. No API key needed or accepted: this mirrors JOA's statistics-only keyless rule exactly. Optionally also returns the daily BETA history series for the same segment.

include_history.description: Also return the daily BETA history series for this exact segment.

role_family.description: Single job family/category value -- see the coverage tool for the live vocabulary.

name: market_signals
title: Aggregate salary and time-to-fill signals (keyless)
